# Acme Realty (demo)

> Demo brokerage recruiting site and free real estate pre-licensing course. Agent recruitment and fit quiz, team directory, partner services, investor education, and a 60-hour interactive Virginia pre-licensing course. All names and contact details are placeholders.

## Main features

- **Two career paths**: join a specialized team or grow independently through the Growth Network program
- **Team directory** with team detail pages and lead routing
- **Agent Advantage**: transactions and operations, financial and legal partners, asset management, and education
- **Free Virginia real estate pre-licensing course**: interactive lessons, practice questions, mock exams, completion certificate
- **Fit quiz**: short assessment to match agents to the right team or path
